cohort: The study included 770 singleton pregnant women who underwent a second-trimester quad screen test at 15-20 weeks gestation, excluding those with pregnancy terminations before 24 weeks or chromosomal/congenital anomalies.
finding: Elevated inhibin A levels (specifically above 2.25 multiples of the median) in the second-trimester quad screen test were significantly associated with preterm labor.
gest_age: Screening performed at 15-20 weeks gestation; outcomes defined as delivery before 37 weeks (preterm) or at/after 37 weeks (term).
